worldcombat.skill.skullbash.summary: Tucks in to charge with temporary armor, Defence and damage reduction, then rams in the locked direction: the first enemy it meets takes contact damage and a shove; a foe whose body is truly pressed to a wall takes a stronger hit, is rooted, and may leave a temporary breach. With no enemy in the way it stops against a wall.
worldcombat.skill.skullbash.use.1: Trade defence for a heavy blow
worldcombat.skill.skullbash.use.2: Pin a foe to a wall
Locks its direction toward the target when charging ends, then rushes up to %1$s blocks. It stops on the first enemy, dealing about %2$s contact damage. The rush cannot turn and stops early on terrain or an ally.

Charges for %1$s with voluntary movement locked, gaining %2$s armor, %3$s damage reduction and up to %4$s Defence stages. Defence and damage reduction linger for 0.4 seconds after charging; the armor ends with the action. Values include the selected stance.
Rushes at %1$s blocks per tick with a %2$s-block collision radius; a hit attempts to shove the target %3$s blocks.

Pinning the target against a wall multiplies this hit by %1$s and roots it for %2$s. The impact also attempts to open up to %3$s blocks in the contacted wall for %4$s before they return. Protected or unbreakable blocks remain intact. A target that does not actually reach the wall takes only the base hit.
worldcombat.skill.skullbash.stance.quick: Quick tuck: a shorter brace with less armour and reduction and a shorter charge, but a faster recovery.
worldcombat.skill.skullbash.stance.deep: Deep brace: a longer brace with stronger armour and reduction, one more defence stage and a longer charge, but a slower recovery.
worldcombat.skill.skullbash.timing: Cast within %1$s blocks; after %2$s seconds it spends %4$s PP, then recovers for %3$s seconds with a %5$s second cooldown from commit.
worldcombat.skill.skullbash.growth.0: At level %1$s, the hit shove rises to %2$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.skullbash.growth.1: At level %1$s, the base Defence boost becomes %2$s stages; Deep Charge adds one more stage.
worldcombat.skill.skullbash.growth.2: At level %1$s, the commit cooldown drops to %2$s seconds.
worldcombat.skill.skullbash.preference.d: On (deep brace): a longer brace with stronger armour and reduction, one more defence stage and a longer charge, but a slower recovery. Off (quick tuck): a shorter brace with less armour and reduction and a shorter charge, but a faster recovery.
worldcombat.skill.skullbash.preference.a: The companion will not brace below this HP fraction; higher is more cautious, lower lets it ram while wounded.
The companion braces and charges a foe within this distance; smaller keeps it close, larger lets it chase out to intercept.
When on, a companion on hold will leave its post to ram a target that enters the engagement radius.
